fields.summary: Reviewers export the claims they have filtered to a CSV file, so they can audit them offline.
fields.problem: Reviewers copy claims into spreadsheets by hand to audit them offline; with long lists this takes hours and rows get lost.
fields.scope: In scope: CSV export of the filtered claims list with the visible columns. Out of scope: PDF, scheduled exports, exports of other lists.
fields.result: Target met: CSV exports per reviewer per week = 4.2 against the target >= 3 (baseline 0, change +4.2). Window: 2026-09-14 to 2026-10-12 (UTC, half-open). Query: posthog events export_csv, distinct reviewers. Measured 2026-10-12 by `aayu measure`.

fields.completion_goal:
